weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit during combat and neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe or inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit, and also, if unit initiates combat and unit's Spd ≥ foe's Spd+10, unit attacks twice.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 50% during combat.

b.d: Inflicts Spd/Res-1 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-2 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-3 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

c.d: At the start of every third turn, if Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-1.
At start of odd-numbered turns, if Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-1.
At start of turn, if Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-1.
